title: Parkway Pantai Limited's deemed interest in Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust rises after payment of management fees in units
body: Parkway Pantai Limited's deemed interest in Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust rose after Parkway Trust Management Limited received units as payment of management fees. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 214,773,268 units (32.90%) to 214,806,301 units (32.91%).
deemed_interest_text: Parkway Pantai Limited's ("PPL") deemed interest in PLife REIT arises through its wholly-owned subsidiaries:- (i) Parkway Investments Pte Ltd ("PIPL") and Parkway Trust Management Limited ("PTML"), wholly-owned subsidiaries of Parkway Holdings Limited ("PHL"), which is in turn wholly-owned by PPL; and (ii) PIPL and PTML are registered holders of 213,257,000 and 1,549,301 of PLife REIT units respectively.
relationship_text: PHL is a wholly-owned subsidiary of PPL.
change_reason: the issue of 33,033 new units as part payment of the base fee component of the management fee

title: Mitsui & Co., Ltd reports change in deemed interest in Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust in payment of management fees
body: Mitsui & Co., Ltd reported a change in deemed interest in Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust in payment of management fees. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 214,992,483 to 215,025,516 units, with the stake unchanged at 32.94%.
deemed_interest_text: Mitsui & Co., Ltd.'s ("Mitsui") deemed interest in PLife REIT arises through its wholly-owned subsidiary, MBK Healthcare Management Pte Ltd ("MHM"). MHM holds more than 20% of the total issued share capital of IHH Healthcare Berhad ("IHH"). Accordingly, Mitsui has a deemed interest in PLife REIT units held by IHH. IHH Healthcare Berhad's ("IHH") deemed interest in PLife REIT is held through the following wholly-owned subsidiaries:- (i) Integrated Healthcare Holdings Limited ("IHHL"), held through nominee company, Raffles Nominees (Pte) Limited - 219,215 of PLife REIT units; (ii) Parkway Investments Pte Ltd ("PIPL") - 213,257,000 of PLife REIT units; and (iii) Parkway Trust Management Limited ("PTML") – 1,549,301 of PLife REIT units. Both PIPL and PTML are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Parkway Holdings Limited ("PHL"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parkway Pantai Limited (“PPL”). PPL is a wholly-owned subsidiary of IHHL, which is in turn wholly-owned by IHH. Accordingly, IHH has a deemed interest in units, direct and deemed, held by IHHL, PIPL and PTML.
relationship_text: MHM is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mitsui.
change_reason: the issue of new units as part payment of the management fee
company_name: Parkway Life Real Estate Investment Trust
